registryAssessment: Local registry/map custody is evidenced by the official Aktobe geoportal system record and the Aktobe regional land-relations department. National eGov guidance documents authenticated or identity/document-based cadastral workflows; those were not used.

GIS vendor/project page links the open Aktobe map at geoportal.akt.kz.
Official service instructions require authentication and parcel/document/identity inputs for copies from a land-cadastral file; no request was submitted.
Official open-data listing identifies a quarterly registered-land-plot dataset for Aktobe Region sourced from EKGN; it is tabular and was not downloaded or retained.
